# Ahila Pillai — Product & Visual Designer

> Ahila Pillai is a product and visual designer for startups, based in Bengaluru, India. She designs web and mobile apps, dashboards, design systems, pitch decks, brand identities, landing pages and motion for AI, SaaS, Web3 and fintech companies, has worked as a founding designer taking products from 0 to 1, and has built her own AI apps. She is available for remote freelance, contract and part-time work.

## FAQ
### Who is Ahila Pillai?
Ahila Pillai is a product and visual designer for startups, based in Bengaluru, India. She covers UX/UI, design systems, branding, pitch decks, landing pages and motion, so a startup can work with one designer for everything.

### What kind of companies does she work with?
Early-stage and growth-stage startups, especially AI, B2B SaaS, Web3, fintech and e-commerce companies. Clients include Certa.ai, Lyzr, CUBE3, Persona and Pier39.ai.

### Is she available for work?
Yes. She takes on remote freelance, contract and part-time projects, and can overlap with US Eastern time.

### How do I hire her?
Email ahilapil.26@gmail.com or message her on LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/in/ahilapillai).
